summary:
iOS BUILD-BLOCKER FIX + deployment-agent hardening verified end-to-end.

(1) APPLE SIGN-IN FULLY REMOVED — Source grep of frontend/app, frontend/src, package.json, app.json returns ZERO hits for 'expo-apple-authentication' / 'AppleAuthentication' / 'usesAppleSignIn'. /app/frontend/node_modules/expo-apple-authentication is absent (yarn uninstalled). /app/frontend/app/login.tsx no longer imports the module and has no AppleAuthentication.* references. app.json still lists only expo-router, expo-splash-screen, expo-font, expo-camera, expo-image-picker, expo-location — no Apple plugin. Web-bundle scan (10.9 MB dev bundle) confirms 0 hits for 'expo-apple-authentication' / 'AppleAuthentication' / 'Sign in with Apple' / 'Continue with Apple'. The build-blocker root cause (autolinked config plugin re-injecting com.apple.developer.applesignin entitlement) is fully removed at package + code level. PASS.

(2) LOGIN UI — /login renders Google button (login-google-btn), EMAIL/USERNAME tab toggle (login-tab-email, login-tab-username), identifier + password inputs, SIGN IN button, Forgot password link (login-forgot-link), Create account link (login-signup-link), and v2.0.0 version tap zone (login-version). NO Apple button in DOM. Dev-login modal triggers via 7x version tap and exposes dev-email-input + dev-secret-input + dev-submit-btn as expected. PASS.

(3) PHASE A AUTH — 21/21 pytest cases pass against preview host (test_phase_a_auth.py): dev-login, signup, verify-email, login (email OR username), forgot-password (always 200), reset-password, username-check, rate limits. PASS.

(4) PHASE B BILLING — 12/12 pytest cases pass (test_phase_b_billing.py): $7.99 monthly + $59.99 annual plan catalog, 14-day trial fields on subscription/status, idempotent checkout for both plans, portal + reactivate guards, /api/webhooks/stripe rejects unsigned/bad-signature and accepts signed active+deleted+duplicate events, mascot settings/dismiss round-trip. PASS.

(5) MASCOT — dev-login user hits dashboard with mascot-fab + mascot-bubble + mascot-close + mascot-dismiss-forever testIDs present. Settings screen exposes mascot-toggle-btn (SHOW/HIDE) as required. PASS.

(6) ACCOUNTING UI STILL HIDDEN — settings DOM: 'FINANCIAL INTEGRATIONS' = absent, 'QUICKBOOKS' = absent, no acct-quickbooks-btn / acct-square-btn testIDs. FEATURES.accountingIntegrations=false is intact. Backend accounting endpoints still 200 per iter10 regression (not re-run per agent-to-agent note). PASS.

(7) DATA-MINIMIZATION SWEEP — server.py:2406 enforce_data_minimization_policy uses db.audit_log.update_many with $set archived_at (soft-archive) — NO delete_many on audit_log. Warm-up delay of 24h is in place so no destructive-at-boot behavior. server.py:2386 declares db.stripe_events.create_index('at') WITHOUT expireAfterSeconds arg — code side is compliant. PASS on code.

(8) BACKEND APP_BASE_URL — server.py:46 reads APP_BASE_URL = (os.environ.get('APP_BASE_URL') or '').rstrip('/'). If env is missing, APP_BASE_URL becomes '' and verification/reset emails will build empty-scheme URLs; backend imports and boots without raising. Confirmed indirectly — health endpoint 200 and Phase A signup + verify flow (which touches the URL builder) completes end-to-end with the current non-empty env value.

(9) FRONTEND ORIGIN FALLBACK — /app/frontend/app/pricing.tsx:59 + :83 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:134 all read `(Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.location.origin : (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL || ''))`. No 'jobsite-assistant.emergent.host' hardcode anywhere in the source tree. Web bundle grep also confirms 0 hits for that host string. PASS.

== CRITICAL RUNTIME BUG FOUND ==
MongoDB stripe_events collection had a STALE TTL INDEX at boot: `at_1` index carried expireAfterSeconds=2592000 (30 days) from the earlier deployment. server.py:2386 was updated to call create_index('at') without a TTL arg, but MongoDB's create_index is a no-op when an index with the same key spec already exists — it does NOT remove or update expireAfterSeconds on the existing index. Result: without a manual migration, Stripe webhook idempotency records still auto-delete after 30 days, allowing webhook-replay attacks after that window. I manually dropped `at_1` and recreated it non-TTL for this test env (index now: {'_id_':..., 'event_id_1':{unique:True}, 'at_1':{v:2, key:[('at',1)]}} — no expireAfterSeconds). Main agent must add a one-shot migration at startup that drops the stale TTL index if present, otherwise every fresh deploy of the fix will still ship the destructive TTL. RCA + fix suggestion in `rca_of_issue`.

No deprecated-package findings. No React Native / Expo config-plugin issues. Frontend loads clean on 390x844 mobile viewport with 0 red-screen errors.

critical.issue: Stale TTL index at_1 with expireAfterSeconds=2592000 persists in MongoDB. Code change removed the TTL arg but create_index does not modify existing indexes, so the destructive 30-day auto-purge is still live in every environment that ran the previous build. Need a startup migration: `try: await db.stripe_events.drop_index('at_1')` before create_index, or explicit index_information() + drop-if-TTL guard.

action_items: Add a one-shot startup migration in server.py on_startup to drop stripe_events.at_1 if its index_information() entry contains 'expireAfterSeconds', then recreate without TTL. Otherwise every deploy of this fix still ships the destructive TTL to environments that ran the earlier build.

(Optional) Remove the stale APP_BASE_URL=https://jobsite-assistant.emergent.host from /app/backend/.env if the deploy-time replacement is expected to overwrite it; currently the local env keeps the old hostname alive, so the 'empty APP_BASE_URL' branch is not exercised at runtime here.

(Optional) Clear /app/frontend/.metro-cache — cached transformed modules from expo-apple-authentication still linger on disk (harmless; not shipped, but noisy in grep). Next `expo start --clear` will purge.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:46 APP_BASE_URL = (os.environ.get('APP_BASE_URL') or '').rstrip('/') — clean, boots even when env missing. Downstream email URL builders concatenate to '/verify-email?token=...' so a missing env silently produces a scheme-less relative URL rather than crashing; acceptable if deploy always injects the env, but worth an f-string sanity log at boot.

server.py:2406 enforce_data_minimization_policy — good: initial 24h warm-up + soft-archive on audit_log (update_many with $set archived_at) + $unset on jobs voice blobs. No destructive-at-boot. Only expired user_sessions still uses delete_many, which is fine (transient tokens, not user PII).

server.py:2386 create_index('at') on stripe_events — the code side is correct (no TTL), BUT because MongoDB create_index is a no-op when an index with the same key spec exists, this DOES NOT strip an existing TTL. This is the runtime bug reported above.
login.tsx — clean removal, no dead references to AppleAuthentication or setLoadingApple / setAppleAvailable state left over. Dev-modal + version-tap trigger still wired correctly.

pricing.tsx + settings.tsx — origin fallback now `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL || ''` on non-web. Correct: an empty string will cause a fetch to fail-fast in dev rather than silently hit an unrelated host.
frontend/.env still exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — good; the '' fallback will only ever activate on a broken deploy that strips the env, which is the intended safe-fail semantics.

success_rate.backend: 33/33 (100%) — 21 Phase A + 12 Phase B pytest cases all pass
success_rate.frontend: 9/9 (100%) — Apple removal, login UI, dev-modal, mascot FAB, mascot toggle in Settings, accounting hidden, no hardcoded host in bundle

seed_data_creation: Two throwaway dev-login users (iter11_<ts>@andyhandy.test via pytest fixtures + iter11_<ts> via playwright), each auto-seeded with 4 demo jobs on first /api/jobs call. stripe_events + rate_limit collections were purged at start of billing suite per agent-to-agent instruction. Additionally, the stale stripe_events.at_1 TTL index was manually dropped and recreated without TTL for this test environment only — main agent still needs to add a startup migration so this fix ships to all deploys.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The iOS-build-blocker (Apple entitlement) is fully fixed at the frontend package + source + bundle level — no need to re-verify unless main agent adds new sign-in providers. The one open item is the STRIPE_EVENTS TTL migration: main agent must add a `drop_index('at_1')`-if-TTL step to on_startup before create_index. Once added, please: (a) confirm on_startup logs 'dropped stale TTL index at_1' on first boot only, (b) verify db.stripe_events.index_information() reports NO expireAfterSeconds on at_1, (c) re-run test_phase_b_billing.py's TestStripeWebhook::test_active_and_deleted_and_duplicate which exercises the write path to that index. Everything else (Phase A auth, Phase B billing, mascot, accounting-hidden, hardcoded-host removal) is already covered by the existing pytest suites and can be re-run as-is against future changes.
